SELECT 'cal' k, fiscal_year||' P'||fiscal_period||' '||period_start_date||' '||period_end_date||' '||weeks_in_period||' '||fully_loaded v FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year LIKE 'FY2026%' AND fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 6
UNION ALL SELECT 'store', store_key||' '||store_id||' '||store_name||' '||format||' '||valid_from||' '||valid_to||' '||coalesce(close_date::varchar,'-') FROM dim_store WHERE store_name ILIKE '%it_j_nm_ki%' OR store_name ILIKE '%Pit%'
UNION ALL SELECT 'closure', closure_id||' '||store_id||' '||closure_type||' '||closure_start_date||' '||closure_end_date FROM ref_store_closure
UNION ALL SELECT 'fy', DISTINCT_FY FROM (SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year AS DISTINCT_FY FROM dim_date)

WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.*, p.sku, p.product_name, p.category
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27')
SELECT 'rows' k, count(*)::varchar a, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id)::varchar b, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id,line_no))::varchar c, sum(quantity)::varchar d, sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN quantity END)::varchar e, sum(CASE WHEN quantity<=0 THEN 1 END)::varchar f, min(etl_loaded_at)::varchar g, max(etl_loaded_at)::varchar h FROM l
UNION ALL SELECT 'chan', channel_code, count(*)::varchar, sum(quantity)::varchar, NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL FROM l GROUP BY channel_code

WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.quantity, f.staff_purchase_flag, p.sku
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'),
r AS (SELECT sales_line_id, sum(quantity_returned) q FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1),
a AS (SELECT l.sku, sum(l.quantity) units, sum(CASE WHEN NOT coalesce(l.staff_purchase_flag,false) THEN l.quantity END) units_ex_staff, sum(coalesce(r.q,0)) ret
 FROM l LEFT JOIN r USING(sales_line_id) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT a.*, (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT product_name,' / ') FROM dim_product d WHERE d.sku=a.sku) names, (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT category,' / ') FROM dim_product d WHERE d.sku=a.sku) cats
FROM a ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 5 AS fiscal_period, p.sku, p.product_name, sum(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar c ON c.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND c.fiscal_period = 5
WHERE s.store_id = 102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN c.period_start_date AND c.period_end_date
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name
ORDER BY units_sold DESC, p.sku
LIMIT 4
